name: astro-practice
description: GOSIM Agentic Observer Hackathon (智能体巡天黑客松) public practice cards L1-L4: an observing agent drives a simulated fibre-fed telescope survey over participant-agent-protocol-v4. Output: an observer project zip (observer.project.json at the root). Scored by the starter kit's own v4 engine (scorer astro-survey); a stage's passed/total is the survey score in milli-points out of 10,000 points (docs/astro-survey.md).
